summary: Returns up to the requested number of likely alternative tokens and their log probabilities at each output position. It is diagnostic output and can substantially increase response size.
combines: The current Responses and Chat Completions request schemas both expose top_logprobs with a range from 0 through 20, and OpenAI publishes no narrower restriction for the reviewed GPT-5.4 through GPT-5.6 models.
Responses requires include: ["message.output_text.logprobs"] to return log probabilities in output message content.
Chat Completions requires logprobs: true when top_logprobs is set.
The API may return fewer alternatives than requested.
